evals.prompt: Set up the harness in this empty project directory, which is not a Git repository.
evals.expected_output: Stops before creating files and reports that the project must be a Git repository.
assertions: Checks that git is available and git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree succeeds before editing files.
Does not create harness artifacts when the Git check fails.

evals.prompt: Set up the harness in this initialized Git project with one pending SDD feature F-001 named Add dark mode.
evals.expected_output: Creates the harness skeleton, repairs the missing SDD feature directory, and generates an init.sh that validates Git and SDD artifacts.
assertions: Creates features/F-001-add-dark-mode/.gitkeep because the registered feature uses SDD.
Generated init.sh fails outside a Git work tree.
Generated init.sh requires exactly one features/F-001-* directory for the SDD feature.
Generated init.sh validates SDD artifacts inside the matching feature directory.

evals.prompt: Set up the harness in this initialized Git project with no SDD features.
evals.expected_output: Creates the global harness state without creating features/.
assertions: Does not create features/ when no registered feature uses SDD.
Generated init.sh does not require a feature directory for non-SDD features.
